description: Holdout test sources for true generalization evaluation. These sources are NEVER used during training or validation.
rationale: Reserve diverse recording conditions for unbiased final evaluation. This gives true generalization metrics rather than same-distribution validation.

enst_drums.description: ENST-Drums - Real recordings with annotations (not MIDI-aligned)
enst_drums.why_holdout: Different recording conditions and annotation methodology than MIDI-aligned sources

mdb_drums.description: MDB-Drums - Multi-track drum recordings with human annotations
mdb_drums.why_holdout: Professional multi-track recordings, different mixing styles

notes.critical: Do NOT include holdout sources in feature_cache for training
notes.evaluation: Run final evaluation using evaluate_holdout.py after training completes
notes.metrics: Report holdout accuracy separately from validation accuracy in all documentation
